raw_response:
This plot is small, only 0.20 hectares, but maize is what feeds my family so I must care for it well. If I can get the FISP coupon this year I will buy one bag of NPK and one bag of urea — that is what the program gives. I also put the manure from my goats and the ash from cooking on the ridges before planting. I keep seed from last year's harvest because hybrid seed is expensive and I am intercropping with pigeon pea and pumpkin, so I do not need to buy new seed. I will work this plot myself with my children; I have no money to pay ganyu workers, and anyway the plot is small.
